# Trunk

> [Trunk](https://www.trunkinventory.com) is multi-channel inventory management software that helps make it easier for businesses to sell across multiple platforms.

Key features:

- Sync stock levels in real-time across multiple platforms via matching SKUs
- Create bundles and kits that sync with respect to each other (e.g. 10-pack, 5-pack, singles)
- Duplicate SKU syncing within the same sales channel
- Low stock level alerts
- Easy-to-use interface

## Main

- [Features](https://www.trunkinventory.com/): Description of Trunk's inventory syncing capabilities as well as answers to frequently asked questions
- [Testimonials](https://www.trunkinventory.com/customers): Reviews from real Trunk customers with mentions of how they use Trunk to solve problems in their businesses
- [Help](https://www.trunkinventory.com/help): Documentation and support resources for Trunk users
- [Contact](https://www.trunkinventory.com/contact): Live chat and email support available

## Use Cases

- Manage the same SKUs across multiple catalogs (public retail, B2B corporate pricing, nonprofit pricing, custom partnerships) without manual inventory splitting
- Link case quantities to individual units (e.g., 25 singles = 1 case) with automatic real-time inventory updates
- Automatically sync returns and cancellations back across all linked SKUs and bundles
